metadata.case_name: LIU SUET UN AN INFANT BY HER NEXT FRIEND LIU PUI CHEUNG v. YU MAN FAI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: compound depressed fractures of the skull bone
source: X-ray examination revealed compound depressed fractures of the skull bone and also a fracture of the shaft of the humerus.
the injuries to the left side of the plaintiff's skull were far more serious.
surgery revealed multiple fractures of the skull bones which were depressed. The fractured segments of bone were elevated

injuries.description: appreciable brain damage involving in particular the left temporal lobe of the brain; the surface of the left temporal lobe of the brain was found to be lacerated; the whole of this lobe was contused and about 8 to 10 c.c. of blood was removed from inside the temporal lobe
injuries.body_part: left temporal lobe of the brain
source: the surface of the left temporal lobe of the brain was found to be lacerated.
In addition, the whole of this lobe was contused and about 8 to 10 c.c. of blood was removed from inside the temporal lobe.
it is evident that there has been appreciable brain damage involving in particular the left temporal lobe of the brain

injuries.description: An area of skull bone measuring 6 cm x 5 cm was removed from the anterior part of the left parietal bone during surgery leaving the underlying brain unprotected.
injuries.body_part: anterior part of the left parietal bone (skull defect)
source: An area of skull bone measuring 6 cm x 5 cm was removed from the anterior part of the left parietal bone during surgery leaving the underlying brain unprotected.

injuries.description: fracture of the shaft of the humerus
source: X-ray examination revealed compound depressed fractures of the skull bone and also a fracture of the shaft of the humerus.
The fractured humerus was simply treated by placing the same in a plaster cast and it is clear from the medical reports that she will make a complete recovery from this injury.

manifestations.description: post-traumatic amnesia from which, according to her father, she did not fully recover for a period of 3 days
initially showed signs of speech disturbance, her speech is now almost normal
An electroencephelogram revealed epileptogenic discharges when the plaintiff hyperventilated.
the plaintiff has become aggressive, bad tempered and unto-operative. She is nervous in public and becomes frustrated over small matters
difficulty, if not impossible, to form relationships with her peers or indeed anyone other than members of her immediate family
I.Q. of 93, on the lower side of the average range; showed rigidity, inflexibility and muddled conceptual thinking characteristic of brain damaged patients
memory functioning: current performance is only weak to adequate
school work has suffered and the deficit in abstract conceptual thinking will increasingly and adversely affect her performance
there is a 31% chance of developing late post-traumatic epilepsy

treatments_received: admission to United Christian Hospital and transfer to Neurosurgical Unit of Kwong Wah Hospital
neurosurgery (elevation of depressed skull bone segments and removal of intracerebral blood)
treatments_future: further surgery to insert an acrylic graft to protect the brain where the skull bone has been removed

losses.description: The plaintiff has become aggressive, bad tempered and unto-operative. She is nervous in public and becomes frustrated over small matters.
She finds it difficult if not impossible, to form relationships with her peers or indeed anyone other than members of her immediate family.

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: Her school work has suffered and the deficit in abstract conceptual thinking will increasingly and adversely affect her performance.
An area of skull bone measuring 6 cm x 5 cm was removed ... leaving the underlying brain unprotected; further surgery is required to insert an acrylic graft to protect the brain.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
